fabricationFlags: Scholarships entirely fabricated: 'PBS Merit Scholarship', 'Women in Management Scholarship' (EUR5,000), 'Diversity Scholarship' (up to EUR4,000) do NOT exist on official site. Official scholarships are Women in Entrepreneurship/STEM/Leadership/Finance (up to 50%), PALOP Leaders Fellowship, Inclusion, Sustainability (up to 30%), Entrepreneurship (up to 30%).
Program 'Master (8) PG(8)' (slug porto-business-school-master-8-pg-8) is a scraping artifact / nonsense title, not a real program.

Fabricated/mislabeled MSc titles: 'MSc Management', 'MSc Digital Transformation Management', 'MSc International Business' do not match PBS naming; PBS uses Postgraduate / Executive Master programmes, not standalone MSc degrees.
Many programUrls point to aggregator topuniversities.com yet are marked verified:true with source 'qs' (not official verification).

Tuition figures fabricated/stale: catalog mba-full-time EUR22,500 vs official Full-Time MBA EUR28,500; International MBA real fee EUR25,175 not represented; MSc fees (EUR14,000-16,000) unverifiable against any official source.
City listed as 'Porto'; official campus is in Matosinhos (Porto metropolitan area).
evidence: Official site pbs.up.pt confirmed. Real MBAs: International MBA, Executive MBA, Global Online MBA, plus Double Degrees and Postgraduate/Executive Master programmes across Management, Innovation/Digital, Marketing/Sales, Finance, Operations/Projects, Sustainability, Internationalization. Accreditations AMBA/AACSB/EFMD confirmed (catalog says AACSB+AMBA, omits EFMD). Rankings: 6th FT Online MBA 2026. Official tuition: International MBA EUR25,175, Full-Time MBA EUR28,500 (deadline-tiered) - catalog tuition (EUR22,500/14,000/16,000/15,500/6,500) does not match. Official scholarships (Women in Entrepreneurship/STEM/Leadership/Finance, PALOP, Inclusion, Sustainability, Entrepreneurship; EUR1.9M awarded 2025) bear no resemblance to the 3 catalog scholarships. Location is Matosinhos per UniPage, catalog says Porto. Accommodation: official mentions only generic 'housing services', catalog entries are generic and unverifiable. Sources: pbs.up.pt/en, pbs.up.pt/en/programas/mba, pbs.up.pt/en/scholarships, unipage.net/en/31357.
